# telnyx_email_domain_webhook (Resource)

A webhook that receives the events of an email domain, such as deliveries, bounces and verification changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_email_domain_webhook" "events" {
  domain_id = telnyx_email_domain.mail.id
  url       = "https://hooks.example.com/telnyx/email"
  events    = ["email.delivered", "email.bounced"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The email domain the webhook belongs to.
- `events` (Set of String) Allowlist of event types delivered to this webhook. At least one event is required — there is no default-to-all.
- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint to deliver subscribed events to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_email_domain_webhook.example <domain_id>/<id>
```
